pages.text: Frequently asked questions about SACCOs, published by the SYN SACCO Societies Authority. Question: How much of a member's deposits does the SACCO Deposit Fund cover? Answer: Up to SYN Sh 250,000 per member. Question: What is the minimum share capital to join a SACCO? Answer: SYN Sh 5,000. These answers are updated whenever the rules change. [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: fictional organisations and invented figures. Not real financial information.]
